screenshots.description: HCS eMR patient dashboard (full app view): left module sidebar, header tabs (Dashboard/Favorites/Census/Demographics/Orders/Clinical Documentation/etc.), and patient banner for demo patient Hopkins, John (71 Year Old Male, DOB 10/10/1946, ID P218200048). Main area shows Intake/Output, Allergies, Vital Signs, Active Orders.

HCS eMAR application medication administration view (full app view): patient banner for demo patient Liddell, Alice Pleasance (DOB 05/05/1992, 25 years, Visit Number W-1112, MRN AIW-1, Female), allergies and diagnoses rows, action tabs (Log Off/Work/History/Discharge/Inpatient/MAR/Orders/Notes/Interventions), and a cardiovascular medication list main area.
